summary.text: Lisa Grafstein is a Democratic member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 13 since January 1, 2023, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as lawyer.

paragraphs.text: Grafstein was born in Amityville, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree from Northwestern University in 1988 and a J.D. from the University of North Carolina School of Law in 1995.

Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a lawyer at Disability Rights North Carolina and the Law Office of Lisa Grafstein, PLLC, and says she has also worked for the North Carolina State Personnel Commission.
Grafstein succeeded Danny Earl Britt, a Republican, in the Senate.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists her as a member of the Agriculture, Energy, and Environment, Appropriations on Justice and Public Safety, Appropriations/Base Budget, Judiciary, and State and Local Government committees.
